verdicts.quote: day offsets **0, +7, +14** from the invoice due date (due date, 7 days overdue, 14 days overdue); **no** reminders before the due date
If it now fails, no email is sent and the slot is recorded `skipped: <reason>` (`paid`, `void`, `disabled`).
verdicts.missing: Credited invoices and payment plans are not addressed; dispute hold is only listed as out of scope, so the spec never says whether disputed invoices keep getting reminders by design

verdicts.quote: outstanding balance 300.00 on a 500.00 invoice with 200.00 paid → body says `300.00 USD`, not 500.00.
Message carries business identity and a reply contact (R-3); no unsubscribe feature.
verdicts.missing: Whether an existing customer do-not-contact, paused or unsubscribed state suppresses reminders, and whether billing notices are exempt from a marketing opt-out

verdicts.quote: only one claim per (invoice, offset) can ever exist ... Overlapping passes, repeated passes, and restarts therefore cannot both send.
Immediately before each send, the system re-reads the invoice and the business setting from their authoritative store (no cache) and re-applies the R-2 eligibility test.
`exhausted` (3 failed attempts) ... A failed attempt is retried on the next evaluation pass. ... provider outage across many invoices → each slot fails and retries independently
verdicts.missing: No escalation or notification to a person when sends keep failing; exhausted slots are only visible in history

verdicts.quote: Mail-provider rate limits are unknown (G-5); a refusal due to throttling is a `failed` attempt.
verdicts.missing: How a large batch is paced to stay within the provider's rate limit

verdicts.quote: When several offsets are due at once (first enablement, outage recovery, late-issued invoice), **only the latest due offset is sent**; earlier ones are recorded as superseded.
Days are calendar days in the **business's time zone** (IANA name). Reminders go out on or after **09:00 local** on the due offset date.
verdicts.missing: The customer's local time, an end to sending hours, and weekends and holidays are not addressed

verdicts.quote: outstanding balance with ISO currency code (two decimals, thousands separator `,`)
invoice has no billing address, or an address failing basic address syntax → no send; record `blocked: no recipient`
verdicts.missing: Bounces are declared out of scope, so it is undecided whether an address known to bounce keeps receiving later reminders or is flagged

verdicts.quote: The channel is **email** to the invoice's customer billing address.
verdicts.missing: What happens when a customer has several billing contacts and which one(s) receive the reminder

verdicts.quote: The invoice-detail view lists reminder history for that invoice, newest first: offset, send-day local date, outcome (R-6 vocabulary), recipient address as used, attempts.
business name, invoice number, outstanding balance with ISO currency code ..., due date as `YYYY-MM-DD` ... A pay-link line is included only if the invoice already has a payment URL (G-2).
verdicts.missing: Whether the payment link expires and what happens if it has

verdicts.quote: An authorised user of that business (G-8: the role that may change business settings) can set it.
verdicts.missing: Which role is authorised is left open (G-8); sending or stopping a reminder by hand is out of scope, so no permission is defined for it

verdicts.quote: each business has one setting, *automatic invoice reminders*: `off` (initial) or `on`.
verdicts.missing: Per-customer off, preview or dry run, and manual resend are not provided (per-customer overrides and send-now are out of scope; preview is not mentioned)

verdicts.quote: Above it, a *next reminder* line: the date of the next offset not yet recorded as final ... outcome (R-6 vocabulary)
**Numeric bound unresolved**: no latency target was given. Proposed (not accepted): passes at least hourly (A-8)
verdicts.missing: No accepted limit on how late a reminder may go out (R-2 allows 'any later time') and no limit on sending volume (NFR-7 excludes it)

verdicts.quote: (4) *invoice record* — **read only**, never modified by this feature; ... Out of scope: payment recording, invoice creation, customer data editing.
